$chapter.source: Node-by-node audit of screen/single cpt/dj/dj-single-page.html and screen/single cpt/location/loc-single-page.html against apollo-core MetaRegistry, 09-plugins/apollo-djs.json, 09-plugins/apollo-loc.json and data-registry.json — 2026-08-08.
$chapter.note: REGISTER-BEFORE-BUILD list. Every entry is something the mockup PRINTS that no registered meta key, taxonomy or derivation can currently supply. Nothing here is registered yet — this chapter is the decision queue, and each item must land in apollo-core/src/Core/MetaRegistry.php (the ONLY legal registrar, per 02-header.CRITICAL_apollo_core_centralization) before the template that reads it ships. Companion annotations live as <!-- @field --> comments in the two mockups.

$mockup_field_contract.method: Every text node and every media src in both mockups was traced to a storage kind. Three outcomes: MAPPED (a registered key supplies it), DERIVED (computable from registered data — the derivation is named), or MISSING (nothing supplies it — listed below).
$mockup_field_contract.hard_rule: NO direct register_post_meta / register_post_type / register_taxonomy outside apollo-core. See 02-header.CRITICAL_apollo_core_centralization.

$philosophy_violations.note: These are not missing fields. They are fields that must NEVER be created, because 01-philosophy forbids the concept. Building storage for them would make the violation permanent. Fix the mockup, do not register the key.

items.verdict: REMOVE. A follower count is the exact metric the platform is built against. No meta key. Replace with a third derived fact from event history (e.g. anos em atividade, from first played event) or drop the pill to two.
RENAME to favoritar (apollo-fav). Icon becomes ri-shining-2-line / ri-shining-2-fill per 07-icons.plugins['apollo-fav']. Storage already exists — apollo_favorites / apollo_favs tables. No new key.

items.prints: Siga o local e seja avisado quando a próxima data cair.
items.violates: $philosophy.NO_SELECTIVE_FOLLOW — 'siga' is the follow verb in Portuguese
items.verdict: REWRITE to the fav vocabulary: 'Favorite o local e a gente te avisa quando a próxima data cair.'

items.prints: Lat -23.5265 · Lng -46.6664 — meta do CPT events_local
items.violates: $apollo_rule.data_flow.production ('no debug output, no helper attributes') — an internal meta name is printed to the visitor, and `events_local` is not even a real CPT slug (the slug is `local`)
items.verdict: REMOVE the note entirely, or reduce to the coordinate pair without the storage hint.

missing.prints: Rio de Janeiro — Hard Groove & Peak Time
missing.derivation: apollo_dj_home_city($id) . ' — ' . implode(' & ', first 2 terms of taxonomy `sound`)
missing.why_not_meta: Two of the three parts already exist as data; a free-text key would let them drift apart. Register the key only as an editorial OVERRIDE, empty by default.
missing.blocker: apollo_dj_home_city() does not exist — the dj CPT has NO city/base meta at all. See dj.home_city below.

missing.prints: (the 'Rio de Janeiro' in the eyebrow, and '9 Cidades' needs a home to count against)
missing.why: There is genuinely no city on the dj CPT. `_loc_city` appears in apollo-djs' meta.post list but it is an event/loc key that leaked into the deep scan, not a dj field. A DJ's base city is a fact about the artist, not derivable from their gig history (a Rio DJ who mostly plays SP would read as an SP artist).

`_dj_booking` holds the CONTACT (an email). Whether the artist is currently taking bookings is a separate, changing fact, and the mockup renders it as a live dot — a state, not a link. The year is derived from current_time('Y').
missing.i18n: open → 'Booking aberto', selective → 'Booking seletivo', closed → 'Agenda fechada'

missing.prints: LEO / JANEIRO as two stacked display lines
missing.derivation: explode(' ', _dj_name) — first token line 1, remainder line 2
missing.why_key_still_needed: The derivation breaks on one-word names (renders one line, hero collapses) and on three-word names (line 2 overflows). Register as an override so an artist can set the break point.

missing.verdict: Do NOT add a second key. Allow a single <em> in _dj_statement and run it through wp_kses( $v, ['em'=>['class'=>[]]] ). One field, one truth; a separate 'which word is gold' key is a foot-gun the moment the statement is edited.

missing.prints: 'Eventos tocados no circuito Apollo' · 'Casas e promotoras diferentes que já bookaram' · 'Cidades — do Rio a Belo Horizonte' · 'Amanheceres que a pista se recusou a soltar'
missing.verdict: Labels 1–3 are template copy and belong in the PHP partial, not the database. Label 3 hardcodes 'do Rio a Belo Horizonte' — that must become the actual min/max city pair from event history or drop the suffix.
missing.blocker: Metric 4, 'Amanheceres', has NO computable source. apollo_dj_compute_stats() cannot produce it: nothing records an event's end hour on the dj side. Either register `_event_end_time` as a required event field and count events ending after 05:00, or REMOVE the fourth metric.

missing.prints: 28 MB · Arquivo zip / 12 fotos · 300 dpi / Rider v3 · PDF / 4 promos · Inéditas
missing.why: `_dj_media_kit_url` is a Google Drive folder. Nothing on the Apollo side can introspect a Drive folder's size, photo count or file list, so none of these four numbers is derivable — they are claims the artist makes about their own kit. Four hardcoded numbers on a press page that contractors read is exactly the kind of thing that goes stale silently.
missing.sanitizer_note: Mirror the _dj_tracks pattern: one apollo_dj_sanitize_kit_stats() used by BOTH the REST path and the apollo-lux-panels metabox, per 20-meta-schemas write_paths.

missing.verdict: No key. The year must never be hardcoded — a 2026 label still reading 2026 in 2027 is the single most common rot on a press page.

missing.prints: Fotos em alta resolução, rider técnico, logos e promos inéditas — tudo em uma pasta só…
missing.verdict: Template copy. Register a key ONLY if artists must customise it; default to the static string.

missing.derivation: newest cover from dj.playedOn (a real crowd shot from a night this artist actually played)
missing.why: A stock photo on an artist's own card is the one thing that reads as unfinished. The derivation gives every DJ a real image for free; the key is the override.
missing.empty_behavior: hide the footer figure — never ship the placeholder

missing.verdict: Brand copy. Belongs in the PHP partial. Note it is Rio-specific and this CPT is not — decide whether it is per-city (then derive from _dj_home_city) or global.

registered_but_never_rendered.note: The reverse gap. These keys exist in apollo-core and have an input surface in apollo-lux-panels, but no node in the mockup reads them — so an artist can fill them and see nothing. Every one is either a missing section or a key to retire.
registered_but_never_rendered.highest_priority: _dj_verified — 07-icons.badges.user_verified is defined (ri-shield-check-fill) and data-registry marks dj.verified as a live field, but the mockup renders no badge anywhere. A verification system nobody can see is a verification system nobody trusts.
registered_but_never_rendered.second: _dj_gallery and _dj_original_project_1..3 have a metabox and no section at all. The DJ page has no gallery and no projects block — either build them or retire four keys.

unwired_links.fix: bind to _dj_instagram — the key exists and is already in APOLLO_DJ's sibling fields

missing.why: data-registry maps local.hero_kicker as DERIVED from _local_city + _local_state + 'copy'. That 'copy' is this string, and it is pure editorial — nothing derives 'Templo do Techno'.
Two printed numbers (23 and 2003) are the same fact stated twice. Store the year, derive the span — otherwise the '23' is wrong on 1 January.

Count AND names are printed; both are venue facts with no source. Store the names, derive the count. `_local_capacity` exists but is explicitly NOT this — and the mockup's own comment says capacity must never be shown.
missing.derivation: count($rooms) for the number; wp_sprintf_l() for the list

missing.verdict: No new key once local.rooms lands. `local_type` already supplies the first half.

missing.prints: the italic run — intensas, escuras e experimentais
missing.verdict: Same call as dj.statement_accent: allow a single <em> inside _local_description via wp_kses, do not add a second key.

missing.prints: D-EDGE — second half of the name in the serif italic
missing.derivation: split _local_name on the last hyphen or space; accent the remainder
missing.blocker: Breaks on single-token names. Same shape as dj.name_lines — resolve both with one convention, not two.

missing.verdict: No new key — the gallery already holds five images and the footer is asking for one of them.

missing.prints: Barra Funda nunca dorme / TE VEMOS NA PISTA
missing.derivation: small = taxonomy local_area term name . ' nunca dorme'; strong = static brand copy
missing.note: The area term already exists (`local_area`). Only the verb is copy.

missing.verdict: The key is READ by single-local.php:231 and WRITTEN by nobody: it is not in MetaRegistrar and has no metabox. Either route depoimentos through apollo-comment (the registered vocabulary — namingRules maps comment/review → depoimento) and retire the meta, or register it with a writer. Shipping a section fed by a key with no input path is how the mockup ends up permanently empty in production.

registered_but_never_rendered.note: _local_postal IS printed inside .map-addr as 'CEP 01156-001' but hardcoded, not bound. _local_image_3..5 have metabox inputs (GalleryMetabox renders 1..5) and the mockup's #gal is JS-built — confirm the builder consumes all five, not two.

naming_tension.finding: namingRules.FORBIDDEN_TERMS maps `venue` → 'USE loc' and `local` → 'USE loc (except in Portuguese text)'. The live meta prefix is `_local_`, the CPT slug is `local`, and the mockup payload still calls it `meta._ap_venue_name`.
naming_tension.verdict: Do not rename anything. The rule is about NEW vocabulary; `_local_*` is the shipped, registered prefix across 32 keys and renaming it would be a migration with no user-visible benefit. Record the tension so the next reader does not 'fix' it. The mockup annotation should say `_local_name`, not `_ap_venue_name`.

next_actions: 1. Resolve the four $philosophy_violations in the mockups. No code, no keys — copy and icon changes only.
2. Decide dj.stats_labels metric 4 ('Amanheceres') — register _event_end_time as required, or cut the metric.
3. Register the 6 META-verdict keys in apollo-core MetaRegistry: _dj_home_city, _dj_booking_status, _dj_media_kit_stats, _local_tagline, _local_founded_year, _local_rooms.
4. Register the 3 override keys as nullable with documented fallbacks: _dj_eyebrow, _dj_name_lines, _dj_footer_image.
5. Widen wp_kses on _dj_statement and _local_description to allow a single <em>.
8. Bump apollo-core AND its version constant together — 19-ssot-audit records apollo-core already sitting at 6.2.3 with uncommitted contract changes.
